title: Module 7: Assessment Design — Validity, Reliability, and Item Construction
description: Design defensible assessments by aligning to objectives, ensuring validity and reliability, writing diagnostic distractors, and using calibrated rubrics for open-ended performance.

learning_objectives.statement: Distinguish content, construct, and face validity, and explain what inference each one supports
Identify common threats to assessment reliability and apply mitigations
Audit an assessment for constructive alignment with its objective at the correct Bloom level
Construct multiple-choice items whose distractors map to specific misconceptions, and design analytic rubrics for open-ended responses

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
